name: python-floyd-warshall
title: Floyd-Warshall All-Pairs Distances
blurb: all-pairs shortest paths over small nonneg-weight integer-keyed digraphs: the matrix's distance table equals the shipped walking oracle's table on every shipped and seeded corpus, the diagonal sits at zero, one more relaxation sweep changes nothing, and an unreached ordered pair stays omitted.
default_description: A distance-table walker whose table equals the walking oracle's table on every small digraph, diagonals at zero and unreached pairs omitted.

verify.name: install
verify.cmd: uv venv --python 3.12 --allow-existing && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e . pytest ruff

detect.contains: the table is the walker's table, pair for pair
